cc:Work.dc:title: analytic-training-cycle
cc:Work.dc:description: Algebraic two-cycle predictions, three squared-error readouts, and cycle multiplier for a tied-weight depth-two scalar network. Green interval denotes attraction. Beyond its boundary the algebraic branch remains but is unstable, not an observed attractor. Fixed-point predictions attain zero error, omitted from the log axis.
